export_controls.text:
It was a true honor to meet the Prime Minister of Spain, Pedro Sánchez, who has been a leader for working people in Spain and a light around the world for his strong stances on humane migration policy, AI regulation, standing up to the Trump administration on the war in Iran, and implementing a permanent arms embargo on arms exports to Israel.

I look forward to continuing to work closely with PM Sánchez to build our power across borders to fight far-right authoritarianism and deliver for working people around the world. ✊🏾

deepseek.reason: The export mention concerns arms exports to Israel, not AI export controls.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement clearly refers to a different export policy area.

export_controls.text:
Trump’s undersecretary who oversees AI exports could not answer my questions about Big Tech’s influence.

The government must have vigorous export controls and a well-established interagency process that is independent from the wishes of corporate CEOs. https://t.co/eTUHvatPvw

deepseek.reason: The speaker says the government must have vigorous export controls.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement explicitly calls for vigorous export controls.

china_race_dynamics.text: We need to work with China… We need to figure out what is the global regulation that everyone is going to be accountable to.

deepseek.reason: The speaker calls for working with China and global regulation rather than prioritizing competition.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The cooperation framing is explicit, but whether it rejects competition priority is inferential rather than directly stated.

astra.reason: The speaker calls for cooperation with China on global regulation without explicitly accepting or rejecting competition as a priority.
astra.confidence_reason: Cooperation is explicit, but the statement does not establish opposition to competition.
